reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 15 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/top-clip/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked bald crown, gray-brown side hair, brows, clean-shaven face, one mouth, suit/patterned tie, collar, backplate, note rows and original right-edge tab versus added top clip.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note has THREE distinct upper gray-mark rows, including an additional lower-left dash row, while the enlarged original has only its existing two compact upper rows. Remove the invented third row and restore only the source-scale upper footprint and original blank areas.

The return adds a long metallic clip across the TOP edge of the note, which is absent from the original, and does not retain the original small dark RIGHT-edge tab in its original position/form. Remove the invented top clip and restore the original small dark right tab without relocating or substituting hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The bald crown retains short gray-brown hair at the sides/back, short gray sideburns and dark-to-gray brows. The face is clean-shaven with no glasses, moustache or beard and one serious closed mouth. The nearly frontal slight-left pose, crop and soft upper-left light remain. The dark suit, white pointed collar and dark tie with a few small pale marks remain without other decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The dark charcoal-green photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the third note row and changed clip/tab structures remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact pale tie pattern and note glyphs are unreadable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on clearly resolved three-versus-two note rows, the added top metal clip and missing original right tab in native/enlarged comparisons, not on tiny writing or alpha numbers.
